notes: Python T2 (`bgraph-eval t2 --ecosystem python`). Root directory defaults to $BGRAPH_EVAL_DIR/t2/python: checkouts <dir> (full clones, core.autocrlf=false, detached at R), one virtual environment venv-<dir> per repo (`uv venv --python 3.13 venv-<dir>`, then the `install` command with `uv pip install --python venv-<dir>/Scripts/python.exe`), oracle.jsonl. Suite: `<venv python> -m pytest <args> --junitxml=F`; `junit_family=xunit1` makes pytest write the `file` attribute that maps testcases to test files, `--continue-on-collection-errors` keeps one import failure from aborting the session (the files that cannot be collected are red). A run without a report (conftest/startup failure) makes every test file red. Unit = test file, as bgraph models it. `mutants` = killed mutants aimed at, `tries` = mutants generated at most. Mutants are one-token operator flips (==/!=, <//>=, >//<=, and/or, is/is not, in/not in, True/False, +/-, simple `return x` -> `return None`) in non-test source; a mutant that does not compile is dropped. Baseline = 2 runs at R; red/differing files are excluded; each red file is re-run alone once to confirm.

repos.name: pallets/click
repos.install: uv pip install --python venv-click/Scripts/python.exe -e click pytest
repos.covers: src/click (a dozen modules), tests/ (21 test files incl. test_types/, test_utils/, test_exceptions/)

repos.name: marshmallow-code/marshmallow
repos.install: uv pip install --python venv-marshmallow/Scripts/python.exe -e marshmallow pytest simplejson tzdata (tzdata: tests/base.py needs the IANA zone database, absent on Windows)

repos.name: python-attrs/attrs
repos.install: uv pip install --python venv-attrs/Scripts/python.exe -e attrs cloudpickle hypothesis pympler pytest==9.* (any pytest 9)
repos.covers: src/attr + src/attrs, tests/ (28 test files, hypothesis-based; ~10 s suite)
